dedupe_keys.name: eu safe and secure truck parking data etpa delegated regulation 885 2013

description: This dataset gathers static data on safe and secure truck parking areas that Member States provide under Article 5 of Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 885/2013, adopted under the ITS Directive 2010/40/EU. The regulation requires public or private parking operators and service providers to share data on such areas through national or international access points, and the Commission's DG Mobility and Transport publishes the files on data.europa.eu. On 2026-09-29 the dataset listed 30 distributions: DATEX II XML files from national or regional providers in Austria (ASFINAG), Belgium (Flanders and Wallonia), Switzerland (ASTRA), the Czech Republic, the German states, Denmark, the Basque Country, Finland, Luxembourg, the Netherlands (NDW), Sweden (Trafikverket) and Slovenia (DARS), plus a map layer and a page of national access points. The metadata give an issue date of 8 March 2016 and a last modification of 7 August 2018. Format and access: XML downloads without registration. Licence and cost: free under the European Commission reuse notice. Caveats: the page states that data quality is the responsibility of each Member State, coverage is partial and the files may be dated. It supports capacity planning of truck parking and freight corridor network models. It relates to the KAMO European truck parking locations and the DATEX II standard in the catalogue.

provider: European Commission, DG Mobility and Transport, with data from Member State access points
